game.title: Like a Dragon: Ishin!
game.blurb: Samurai-era action-adventure set in 1860s Kyo, from Ryu ga Gotoku Studio, released 2023-02-21. RAWG average playtime: 10 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 1805480)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Like_a_Dragon:_Ishin!
Fandom (yakuza.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://yakuza.fandom.com/wiki/Like_a_Dragon:_Ishin!
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0, marked "Perfect stub article"); it links Walkthrough, Substories, Minigames, Gameplay, Controls and Achievements subpages, but only "Controls" and "Table of Contents" exist, so nothing was used. yakuza.fandom.com answers the API with about 116 linked articles, including "Like a Dragon: Ishin!/Chapter 1" to "/Chapter 13", "/Finale", "/Substories" and "Battle Dungeon"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "Macan" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 1805480. 10 of 56 Steam achievements are hidden; 9 read like story milestones and sit in the story chapter. "Showoff" (hidden, 7.2%) also sits there, though it may well be a side goal.
